source.method: Native water polygons clipped to retained source tile bounds. Fine z15 water replaces coarse z12 water only within detailed tile coverage. Tile-clipped polygons preserve native island/shore holes;boolean clipping uses centimeter-snapped unrotated east/south coordinates to avoid nearly collinear rotated tile seams. No inferred full rectangular water plane.

limitations: Common static Y=0 water reference for sea and lake,matching the source sea-level attachment. Exact tides,seasonal lake levels,flow and shoreline terrain accuracy remain unverified.

layers.name: Mapped Wadden Sea and IJsselmeer;declared static reference
